raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-MAR-SecondIdentityTargetingSocialProtection",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Inaccurate or incomplete data in the NPR/SR due to poor quality of legacy databases and biometric deduplication errors, leading to exclusion or duplicate IDs.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Conduct comprehensive data quality audits, implement automated validation rules, and run pilot reconciliations before full rollout; allocate resources for manual correction where needed.",
      "evidence": "Section 11: mixed data quality and risk of inaccuracies when reconciling multiple databases."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Delay or failure in operationalizing the National Registry Agency (NRA), jeopardizing governance of NPR and SR.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Develop a detailed NRA staffing and governance plan with clear timelines; monitor recruitment milestones; provide technical assistance from World Bank to accelerate setup.",
      "evidence": "Section 35‑36: NRA operationalization essential; rapid expansion has strained capacity."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Enrollment and DCSID attribution targets (e.g., 21 million IDs by 2028) not met, reducing coverage of social protection.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement monthly enrollment dashboards, prioritize high‑density rural provinces, and deploy additional mobile units where enrollment lags.",
      "evidence": "PBC tables: target 21 million DCSIDs by FY 29."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Fiduciary risk from reliance on Excel spreadsheets and overlapping budget lines, causing reporting errors or misallocation of funds.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt the planned financial software for IFR preparation; harmonize budget codes; conduct quarterly internal audits to detect duplication.",
      "evidence": "Section 68‑70: use of Excel and duplicate AMO‑TADAMON budget line identified as FM risk."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Exclusion of vulnerable groups (women, disabled, remote populations) due to inadequate communication, outreach or unclear registration procedures.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Roll out multilingual, multi‑channel awareness campaigns; strengthen CSC and mobile‑unit support; monitor enrollment disaggregated by gender and disability.",
      "evidence": "Sections 84‑87: risk of exclusion from inefficient communication and registration."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Generation of electronic waste from mobile units and ICT equipment without proper disposal, causing environmental harm.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Implement the MoI e‑waste management procedure; train field staff on proper disposal; partner with certified recyclers.",
      "evidence": "Section 85‑86: e‑waste risk from electronic devices."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Changes in national data‑protection regulations or non‑compliance could halt digital ID operations.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain a legal watch team; align system design with Law 09‑08 and international best practices; update privacy‑by‑design features as laws evolve.",
      "evidence": "Section 55‑57: data‑protection by design and reference to Law 09‑08."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Insufficient institutional capacity within the Ministry of Interior and PMU to manage simultaneous NPR rollout and NRA establishment.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Scale up staffing, provide targeted capacity‑building workshops, and delegate routine tasks to the Center of Excellence once operational.",
      "evidence": "Section 52‑53: rapid expansion strained MoI capacity; need for long‑term commitment."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Severe climate‑related shocks (drought, floods) increase demand for social protection faster than the system can process, overwhelming NPR/SR.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Integrate real‑time climate‑impact alerts into the DSPDS; pre‑position emergency response protocols; allocate contingency budget for surge enrollment.",
      "evidence": "Section 3‑4: climate shocks account for 37 % of GDP volatility and threaten livelihoods."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Macroeconomic downturns (inflation, recession) reduce fiscal space, threatening project financing and sustainability of social programs.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Secure multi‑year budget commitments; explore cost‑saving digital processes; maintain a reserve fund for cash‑flow gaps.",
      "evidence": "Section 3: COVID‑19 recession and 2022 inflation shock impacted growth."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Cybersecurity breach or unauthorized access to biometric and socioeconomic data, eroding public trust.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement robust encryption, regular penetration testing, and an incident‑response plan; train staff on data‑handling protocols.",
      "evidence": "Section 55‑57: data‑privacy safeguards and EFC monitoring system."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Reluctance of informal‑sector workers to provide personal data, leading to under‑coverage of a large labor segment.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct targeted outreach explaining benefits and data protection; offer optional low‑cost enrollment incentives; engage labor unions.",
      "evidence": "Section 53: informal workers wary of providing information due to tax concerns."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Potential delays in procurement of maintenance contracts for biometric and IT systems, affecting system uptime.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Use the existing STEP system for early procurement planning; keep standby service agreements with current vendors.",
      "evidence": "Section 79‑80: procurement risk assessed as low but requires POM procedures."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Late establishment of the Center of Excellence, limiting technical support and sustainability of the NPR platform.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Define a clear workplan with milestones; allocate dedicated budget; monitor progress quarterly and adjust staffing as needed.",
      "evidence": "Component 3 description: Center of Excellence to support sustainability."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Inadequate monitoring of error, fraud, and corruption (EFC) leading to undetected leakages in social transfers.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy the EFC monitoring system as designed; conduct regular audits; integrate automated anomaly detection algorithms.",
      "evidence": "Section 30‑31: design of end‑to‑end EFC monitoring system."
    }
  ]
}
